boundary_decision.interaction: None. The term is defined inside the Run Context and crosses no boundary.

domain_forces: The definition was placed in the Context Map only because the adr-citations gate refused a Registry citation to a decision document; that gate now exempts digest-backed Domain Memory records.
The Context Map is scheduled for removal once this Plugin matures, so a definition living there would take the record's evidence with it.
Git already keeps the history of a decision document, which is the property the definition needs.
implementation_design.decision: Move the definition into the decision that owns Run orchestration and repoint the record's evidence at it.
rejected_alternatives: Leave the definition in the Context Map: that document is going away.
Leave the record citing a line that no longer exists: verify-evidence reports it stale and a stale reviewed record is worse than a candidate.

record.name: Run
record.definition: One requested trial of a single Skill Version against a single frozen Test Case snapshot, within a Workspace, carried out through one or more attempts on a sandbox Provider, and ending in a single terminal status. An attempt is the execution; the Run is the retryable unit whose identity a reassignment does not change.

approvals.scope: Moving Run's definition into the decision that owns Run orchestration, replacing the approval that placed it in the Context Map
